description_preview: Junior Product Engineer JOB TITLE Junior Product Engineer REVISION DATE 06/01/2026 DEPARTMENT Product Management REPORTS TO Sr. Product Manager LOCATION Endicott, NY FLSA STATUS Exempt Job Description Summary: The Junior Product Engineer serves as a key technical interface between customers, sales, and internal engineering and product management teams for electrical connectors and cable assemblies. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, providing technical and sales support, product selection assistance, and ensuring clear communication to and from our global teams to support successful customer design in's. Company Introduction Amphenol Industrial Operations, headquartered in Endicott, New York with global manufacturing, sales and marketing locations, specializes in delivering a comprehensive range of high-reliability power and signal connectors along with interconnection systems designed specifically for industrial applications. Our solutions cater to diverse industrial sectors such as alternative energy, power generation and storage, rail and mass transit, process control, automotive manufacturing, heavy equipment, wireless base stations, and petrochemical industries. Our product portfolio encompasses power interconnects utilizing RADSOK® contact technology, ruggedized military derivative commercial cylindrical connectors such as AC Threaded (SAE AS50151 style), PT (MIL-DTL-26482 style) and GT reverse bayonet style, assemblies and harnesses using these and other industry standard interconnect. With a dedicated team of over 900 skilled professionals and certifications including ISO9001 and IATF 16949, Amphenol Industrial Operations consistently meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Amphenol Industrial Operations proudly operates as a business unit of Amphenol Corporation, headquartered in Wallingford, Connecticut. Essential Duties & Responsibilities: Customer Engagement & Requirements Definition Act as a primary technical point of contact for customers during early-stage product discussions. Coordinate between our global sites and teams to provide a single channel to the customer in their time zone. Work with customers to gather, clarify, and document product requirements, including electrical, mechanical, environmental, and regulatory needs and confirm product suitability. Assist customers in product selection/configuration based on their applications Interpret internal validation and performance data to ensure product suitability and application risk Translate customer needs into clear internal specifications and requirements documents Support technical discussions related to connector selection, cable construction, shielding, and performance expectations Build and maintain product documentation with product managers and pricing / tech teams. Quoting & Technical Sales Support Partner with sales teams to review RFQs (Requests for Quote) and provide technical input Assist in defining product scope, materials, and manufacturing processes for accurate costing Help develop product concepts and preliminary solutions aligned with customer requirements Participate in customer calls, design reviews, and technical presentations Assist in the development and revision of pricing / stocking pkg strategies, price file creation, and cost analysis. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate tasks for a team, outline timelines for projects. Lead CFT meetings for product support scope. Collaborate closely with design engineers to ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and properly implemented Communicate product gaps, new feature or performance requirements to product managers. Serve as a liaison between customers and internal teams during product development (specific to configuration and customization of standard product). Support communication of design changes, feasibility concerns, and technical trade-offs Provide technical guidance on standard products to internal teams for prototype and production ramp up. Standard Product Development Support Track project milestones and ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal deliverables Ensure new product iterations/configurations are on time and align with NPI requirements. Assist in managing new product introduction (NPI) from concept through production Support prototype review and customer feedback cycles Support engineering change requests (ECRs) and documentation updates Quality & Issue Resolution Support investigation of customer complaints or product issues by gathering field data and clarifying requirements Participate in root cause discussions and help communicate findings and corrective actions to customers Ensure customer specifications align with applicable standards and manufacturing capabilities Qualifications Education & Experience Requirements Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field 0-2 years of experience in engineering, applications engineering, or technical sales (internships included) Basic understanding of electrical systems (signal, power, shielding, grounding concepts) Familiarity with connectors, wire types, cable assemblies, and harnessing preferred Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications Comfortable working with BOMs, product specs, and cost drivers Basic CAD familiarity is helpful but not required Familiarity with ERP/PLM systems Strong communication skills (especially explaining technical concepts to non-engineers) Customer-focused mindset with strong listening and clarification skills Ability to organize and document requirements clearly and accurately Strong coordination and project tracking abilities Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail Flexibility to work across global time zones as required. description_preview:
Until is a moonshot company building a “pause button” for biology. Our near-term focus is organ-scale reversible cryopreservation: preserving donated organs at subzero temperatures without ice formation, then rewarming them uniformly for transplant. By solving this grand challenge, we’re laying the foundation for whole-body reversible cryopreservation, giving patients a bridge to future cures.
To achieve our goal, we are assembling an interdisciplinary team to develop perfusion systems, cryoprotectant formulations, vitrification and rewarming hardware.
We envision a future where no transplantable organ is lost to logistics, and no terminal diagnosis is final because patients can safely wait for future medicine to arrive.
About The Role
As an integration engineer at Until, you'll be working across teams to deliver next-gen perfusion, cooling, and rewarming systems. Successfully owning the deployment of these systems will require you to autonomously work across hardware/software stacks and work closely with scientists across the company.
About You
3+ years of relevant engineering experience
Mechanical design and fabrication experience (rapid prototyping, 3D printing, etc)
Experience designing electrical circuits from protoboard to PCB
Experience with object oriented programming in C++/python
Experience writing control software
Track record of exceptional engineering
Desire to join a small, fast paced team on an excellent adventure
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with fluidic circuits (heat exchange, perfusion, etc.)
Experience working in a research biology context

title: STAFF/PROJECT ENGINEER
description_preview:
Staff/Project Engineer
Staff/Project Engineer
Wheat Ridge, CO (Corporate) and Rockville, MD (Branch) Offices
Olson Engineering, Inc.
Experience: 0 to 5 years
Compensation: $65K to $80K per year
Minimum Education: Bachelors in Structural, Geotechnical or Materials Engineering (Graduate Degree Preferred)
Olson Engineering has openings in our Wheat Ridge, Colorado corporate office and our Rockville, Maryland branch office for Staff/Project Engineers with backgrounds in Structural, Geotechnical or Materials Engineering with strong interest in conducting nondestructive evaluation (NDE) investigations of bridges, buildings, dams, tunnels, pavements, foundations, and other civil structures. Olson Engineering, Inc. is a leader in nondestructive evaluation and geophysical services for civil structural and infrastructure projects. We cross-train our professionals to work on NDE and engineering geophysics projects. Our subsidiary, Olson Instruments, Inc., manufactures instruments for nondestructive evaluation for civil engineering projects. This position will be approximately 25 to 40% in the field with both local and out of town project work. The ability to travel nationally and internationally for longer times of up to 2 to 3 weeks at a time on projects is occasionally required. Strong data collection, data analysis and verbal and written communication skills are required as well as the ability to work individually and as a part of a team. Must be willing to work occasional nights/weekends, and travel on short notice. Must have a clean driving record and ability to pass drug tests when required by clients for project sitework.
Minimum Qualifications
BS in Structural, Geotechnical, and/or Materials Engineering with Graduate Degree a plus
Must be able to travel extensively nationally and internationally
Ability to conduct fieldwork in difficult conditions
Comfortable working at heights
Must be able to repeatedly lift 70 lbs
EIT registration – PE registration is a plus
Duties Include
NDE and Geophysical data acquisition
NDE and Geophysical data processing and analysis
Preparation of draft reports
Preparation of draft proposals
Communicate and coordinate with clients
Desirable Educational Or Work Experience
NDE methods such as Impact Echo, Sonic Echo, Surface Waves, Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity/Echo, Ground Penetrating Radar, Corrosion, Infrared Thermography, Pile Integrity, Structural Health Monitoring
AutoCAD/Solidworks
AASHTO/NHI/Bridge design/load rating/inspection experience/certifications
Finite element modeling experience
Strong engineering mechanics/materials background
Bridge Design and Inspection

Foundation Evaluation

Differential GPS
Photogrammetry
Desirable Software Experience And Other Skillsets
Structural/Geotechnical Finite Element Analyses
Structural Analysis Software
Radar data analysis software
GIS (either ArcGIS or QGIS)
Basic understanding of instrumentation for NDE
Basic understanding of digital signal processing
MS Word and Excel Spreadsheets
Company Benefits
Paid time off commensurate with experience.
Company paid United Health Care HSA health care plan
Optional Vision and Dental Plan
UNUM Long-term Disability and AD&D Insurance.
Simple IRA Plan match up to 3 percent
Paid Holidays

title: Lead Developer (US Remote)
description_preview:
Lead Developer
Salary:
$105,000 - $130,000 USD
At
Shift Lab
, we believe the best products come from great collaboration. We’re a close-knit team of passionate developers, designers, and innovators working remotely across the U.S. If you’re a highly skilled
Lead Developer
looking for a place where your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and teamwork is at the core of everything we do—we want to hear from you.
About The Role
As our
Lead Developer
, you’ll be at the heart of our collaborative process, working closely with designers, project managers, and other developers to bring cutting-edge solutions to life. You’ll not only guide the technical direction of our projects but also mentor and support your teammates through thoughtful code reviews, knowledge sharing, and agile planning.
What you’ll do
Lead with Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with a team of talented developers to design, build, and optimize both front-end and back-end solutions.
Empower Others: Lead by example in providing peer code reviews (via PRs) and offering mentorship to junior developers, ensuring we maintain a high standard of quality and continuous learning.
Sprint Together: Engage in Agile development practices, helping define project tasks and accurately estimating work in a highly collaborative environment.
Develop & Deliver: Use your expert skills in Next.js, Typescript, React, and Tailwind CSS to craft clean, scalable, and innovative code.
Write & Share: Create clear, actionable Jira stories, break down complex tasks, and articulate technical requirements that benefit the entire team.
What We’re Looking For
Experience: You have 5+ years of experience building full-stack applications and are confident leading development efforts.
Technical Expertise: You’re an expert in Next.js, Typescript, React, Tailwind CSS, and Contentful—able to solve complex problems and deliver solutions.
Agile & Git: You thrive in an Agile development environment and have solid experience with Git workflows.
Team Player: You communicate well, whether you’re breaking down technical requirements or giving feedback during a code review.
Mentorship: You believe in lifting others up, offering constructive feedback, and ensuring everyone grows together.
Education: Whether you have a formal education in software development or equivalent real-world experience, your skills are what matter most.
Why Shift Lab?
Fully Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere in the U.S. and collaborate with teammates from across the country.
A Truly Collaborative Culture: We believe in building together, not just individually. At Shift Lab, every team member’s voice is heard, and every contribution matters.
Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $130,000 USD based on experience, plus benefits.
Room to Grow: You’ll work on exciting, impactful projects and have endless opportunities to expand your skill set.
Innovative Projects: Help create amazing, tech-driven solutions for a wide range of industries, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
At Shift Lab, we craft beautiful, user-driven experiences, connecting the dots between client ambition, conceptual design thinking, and thoughtful code. From extending a creative director’s vision in a digital product to reinventing systems that improve our quality of life, we create innovative user experiences and technical solutions.
We are strongest when we collaborate with creative partners and business leaders who value transparency, iteration, and craft. We’re for those who seek a team of creative, but technical, experimental yet focused; esoteric digital experts who know how to explain things.
Our projects are typically bespoke to the creative or cultural technology challenge at hand. An agile development process keeps us open and responsive to every evolving user need. We’re headquartered on the East Coast of the United States, but our team is fully remote across all US time zones.
We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA+, immigrants, those with disabilities, and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. Even if you don’t think your current skill set checks every box below, but this role seems to align with your strengths, we want to hear from you.
